He even broke his leg trying to jump-dive from the pier that day. Jolly fellow dreamt of setting up an airsoft field all the time. It seems his wish came true in Tarkov, the best and largest airsoft field in the world, with an only minor difference: here, you die and lose everything from a single stray bullet. Put together an AK-102, with a Ferfrans CRD Concussion Reduction Device, Magpul AFG OD tactical grip, Zenit Klesch-2U flashlight, RPK-16 buffer tube, and the Circle 10 magazine. Ergonomics should be over 53, recoil sum less than 300, sighting range 800 or more. Make sure it doesn’t take up more than 8 slots.}} ==Objectives== * Modify an [[AK-102]] to comply with the given specifications ==Rewards== * +10,000 [[EXP]] * 165,000 Roubles ** 173,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 189,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 1× [[AKM/AK-74 Hera Arms CQR47 pistol grip/buttstock]] * Unlocks purchase of [[AKM/AK-74 Hera Arms CQR47 pistol grip/buttstock]] at [[Mechanic]] LL4 {{quote|Just don't turn on the flashlight unless you want to get blinded for days! Anyway, well done, leave it on that crate.}} ==Guide== [[AK-102]] specifications: * 60 Durability * 53 or more ergonomics * 300 or less recoil * 800 or greater sighting range * 8 or fewer cells * [[Ferfrans CRD 5.56x45 Concussion Reduction Device]] * [[Magpul AFG tactical foregrip (Olive Drab)]] * [[Zenit Klesch-2U tactical flashlight]] * [[RPK-16 buffer tube]] * [[SLR-106/AK 5.56x45 Circle 10 30-round magazine]] ==Build== '''Notes:''' * This build is based on a standard [[AK-102]] from [[Mechanic]] LL3. * The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
